facts.fact: Vanguard reported on 2026-07-15 that banks, telecom operators, insurers and fintechs authenticate customers by fingerprint or face against NIN records through NIMC's real-time verification platform, as the NIMC Director-General says, and a bank digital officer confirmed verifying identity against the national database.

The NIMC Director-General says agencies for taxation, immigration, education, health, security, aviation and social programmes rely on the NIN, alongside banks, telecoms and insurers; Vanguard states NIN enables verification across banking, telecommunications and immigration.

note: The date is the story's published date; it gives none for the stated use. No figure for verifications or relying services is given.
